items.title: Turing sets out practical agenda on frontier AI risks and launches transformative AI security workstream
items.summary_en: According to a search-result summary of the Turing's news page, the institute published a report arguing that AI verification and assurance can help strengthen national resilience. It also launched a £2 million workstream on transformative AI security risks, funded by Coefficient Giving.
items.notes: Outside the 2026-11-04 to 2026-11-14 window; included only as background for the AI security theme. The date and details come from a web-search summary, not from reading the page, because direct fetch failed. Verify before use.

items.title: Second Women in AI Security Workshop co-led by the Turing's Laboratory for AI Security Research
items.summary_en: A search-result summary says the second edition of the Women in AI Security Workshop was announced or held around 3 November 2026. It was co-led by the institute's Laboratory for AI Security Research.
items.source_name: The Alan Turing Institute – News (listing page)
items.notes: One day before the collection window. No item-level URL was available, so this links to the news listing page. Details come from a search summary only. Treat as low-confidence and verify.

items.title: Adrian Belton appointed Chair of the Turing's Board of Trustees
items.summary_en: The Turing homepage, as summarized by a search tool, says Adrian Belton has been appointed the new Chair of the Board of Trustees. This is a governance item, not a research result.
items.notes: One day before the window. It is likely of low relevance to a frontier-AI research report. Based on a search summary only, not a page read.

coverage_note: Direct WebFetch of www.turing.ac.uk failed with a DNS error (ENOTFOUND). The host appears to be outside the session's allowed network domains, so www.turing.ac.uk would need to be allowed in the session's network settings for a direct read. All items come from one web-search summary restricted to turing.ac.uk, so none were verified against the primary pages. That search found no Turing AI research items dated 2026-11-04 to 2026-11-14. The newest items were from 3 November. Other items in that summary were the satellite-component recognition AI model (2026-10-09) and trustee appointments (2026-10-05). I left these out because I had no item-level URLs and did not invent any. The summary also listed events: 'From idea to investment: building robust AI use cases' (2026-11-11) and the Emerging Digital Methodologies Conference (2026-11-18). The search tool also warned that the site's date labels are inconsistent. A re-run with direct site access is recommended before the report relies on this target.
